description: An eight-channel drum machine that plays itself: a library of pattern sets, and one internal pressure that builds each bar and vents as a fill

params.text: Sets how much pressure builds per bar; turning it up makes the kit more restless
Sets how much pressure each fill spends; turning it up makes the fills come further apart and hit harder
Shifts the intensity tier away from what the pressure calls for, -2 to 2; at the centre it follows the pressure
Sets how many bars the phrase the fills organise themselves around lasts: 4, 8 or 16
Picks which pattern set is played, from the shipped banks and any of your own
Sets the most notes the variation layer may add per bar, 0 to 8; at zero the variation is off
Delays that channel's off-beats, 0 to 50 per cent
Returns the sequence to its start on each press
Moves to the next entry in the queue on each press, taking effect at the next cycle
Rolls a fresh variation layer on each press

inputs.text: Each rise fires the next step; the module has no timebase of its own and freezes when the clock stops
Marks the downbeat, and the time between rises is what tells the module how many clocks make a bar
A rise returns the sequence to its start
A rise rolls a fresh variation layer
Changes how much pressure builds per bar, added to the accumulate knob
Changes how much pressure each fill spends, added to the discharge knob
Shifts the intensity tier, ±5V added to the tier knob
Picks the pattern set, added to the set knob
Sets the most notes the variation layer may add, 0-10V for none to eight
A rise moves to the next entry in the queue at the next cycle
Sets the phrase length, one volt per phrase length, added to the phrase knob

outputs.text: That channel's gate, of the length set on the menu
That channel's velocity for the step it has most recently fired
That channel's accent trigger, fired on the accented hits
Carries 10V for as long as a fill is playing, for ducking a pad or opening a send exactly when the kit breaks
Which pattern set is playing, one volt per set
The set's time signature numerator at half a volt per count, for a Meter reading its time signature CV absolutely
The set's time signature denominator, one volt per index through 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32
The set's tempo at a hundredth of a volt per beat per minute, for a Meter reading its tempo CV absolutely

notes: the module needs an external clock: steps fire on the clock's edges, so whatever swing the clock carries is the kit's swing too
the pattern browser, the queue and the favourites are all on the display, which cannot be reached by clicking for help
the extras control is a ceiling rather than an amount, and each set carries its own limit on how far its identity may bend, so a set keeps its character at full restlessness
menu: Fills: Free (russian roulette), Synced to phrase — chooses whether a fill can land anywhere or only at the end of a phrase
Clock — a label over the clock resolution choice below it
Clock resolution — sets how many clock pulses make a beat, or has it measured from the time between bar pulses instead
Play fills — switches the fills off, leaving the kit playing its pattern without breaks
Queue advance: By repeat count, By NEXT input only — chooses whether the queue moves on by itself after each entry's repeats or only on the NEXT button and jack
Clear queue — empties the queue of pattern sets
Intensity — a label over the two tier items below it
Tier follows: Rise through the phrase, One tier per phrase — chooses whether the intensity climbs across a phrase or is fixed for the whole of it
Tier balance: Even thirds, Main-heavy (stays basic longer), Slow build — sets how the pressure is divided between the sparse, main and lift tiers
Outputs — a label over the pulse width choice below it
Gate/trigger width — sets how long each gate and accent pulse lasts: a fixed 1, 2, 5 or 10ms
Open user patterns folder — opens the folder in Rack's own user directory where your own pattern files go
Import pattern from URL (clipboard) — downloads a drum-patterns.com pattern from a URL already on the clipboard and adds it to your own patterns
